attack_surface: Provider HTTP responses are parsed by undici in the pinned Pi process, including shared-cache directives and retry handling.
Model- or provider-derived text can reach brace expansion and protobuf parsing paths in the Pi dependency tree, creating process availability risk.
The accepted High findings include cross-user information disclosure and parse-time crash; this exception does not claim those vulnerabilities are fixed.
mitigations: Pi runs as a project-scoped subprocess with bounded capability subprocess time and output limits; simulator children receive no provider credentials.
The model receives only allowlisted project tools, and grid-agent persists no provider payload bodies or credentials in evidence.
Operators should use trusted providers and avoid multi-user shared HTTP cache infrastructure until the target Pi upgrade is validated.
The deterministic exception gate fails on expiry, pin drift, vulnerable lock-version drift, or a worsened declared severity count.
upgrade_trigger: Upgrade to the first Pi release at or above 0.84.3 that passes canonical request capture, extension registration, stdout envelope, offline E2E, and package artifact gates; do not renew this exception instead of executing that validation.
